definition: The dissolved oragaanic carbon normalized absorbance at 254 nanometers
notes: Can be related to dissolved organic matter aromaticity. Weishaar et al. 2003; doi: 10.1021/es030360x.
Higher generally related with lower molecular weight dissolved organic matter (DOM). Helms et al. 2008; doi: 10.4319/lo.2008.53.3.0955.

definition: R-squared for the spectral slope from 275 to 295 nanometers

notes: Higher values generally indicated more aromatic; higher molecular weight dissolved organic matter (DOM). Helms et al. 2008; doi: 10.4319/lo.2008.53.3.0955.

definition: R-squared for the spectral slope from 350 to 400 nanometers
Spectral slope ratio. Defined as the ratio of S275_295/S350_400
notes: Related to dissolved organic matter molecular weight. Helms et al. 2008;  doi: 10.4319/lo.2008.53.3.0955.

definition: The ratio of absorption at 250 to 365 nanometers.

notes: Related to contribution of microbial (high) versus terrestrial sources (low). McKnight et al. 2001; doi: 10.4319/lo.2001.46.1.0038.
Related to the degree of humification. Ohno 2002; doi: 10.1021/es0155276.
Related to freshly produced dissolved organic matter. Parlanti et. al. 2000; doi: 10.1016/S0146-6380(00)00124-8.
